scope: Docs-only reconciliation of the a86feeae performance regression with the retained c56d2d80 regression investigation. No benchmark, build, or source test was executed for this receipt.

currentRun.disposition: The 2,000-message median exceeded the 20 percent threshold, so the a86 performance lane remains failed. The passing larger scales and resource soak do not override that result.

c56Investigation.disposition: The quiet c56 follow-up remains separate evidence under different observed conditions. It did not erase the c56 failed report or establish a replacement baseline.

changedMeasuredProductionFile.exactChange: finalize_mailbox_snapshot_inner now counts the staged mailbox_snapshot_items for the account, mailbox, and generation inside its transaction, then rolls back unless that count equals initial_exists.
changedMeasuredProductionFile.pathRelevance: The bounded snapshot benchmark reaches snapshot finalization, so this inventory fence is on its measured production path.

sourceDifferenceFromC56.interpretation: The inventory fence is a verified on-path difference between c56 and a86. No exact paired c56 and a86 binary run isolates it, so this receipt does not attribute the 2,000-message regression to that query or to any other source change.

observerFindings.thermalProbe: The system probe returned no recorded thermal, performance, or CPU power warning. That output does not prove the absence of throttling during the complete run.

cargoAndCompiler.interpretation: The runner intentionally invokes Cargo once per test, so the observed Cargo processes are expected and are not evidence of unrelated compilation. No rustc process or Cargo build-lock wait was observed.

observerFindings.interpretation: The observer proves that unrelated load was present at sampled moments. Its intermittent process snapshots cannot assign any portion of the measured regression to that load.

reconciliation.baselinePolicy: Keep the c47 560 millisecond median as the declared historical reference. Neither the c56 quiet follow-up nor the a86 regression creates a new baseline.
reconciliation.evidencePolicy: Retain the c56 failed run, the c56 quiet follow-up, and the a86 failed run as distinct observations with their original source and environment bounds.
reconciliation.nextProofRequirement: A causal source claim requires a controlled paired run from preserved, hash-bound source variants or binaries that differ only in the candidate change, executed in alternating order under the same observed conditions.

limitations: No benchmark, build, or test was executed during this docs-only investigation.
The a86 report compares with a historical c47 report, not an exact rebuilt and paired c47 artifact.
The c56 quiet follow-up used a direct preserved binary, while the a86 full run used the Cargo runner, so their absolute medians are not a controlled A/B comparison.
The benchmark uses the unoptimized Cargo test profile, and no exact c56 to a86 code-generation comparison was retained.
Observer snapshots are intermittent and unrelated user processes were not stopped.
The run does not measure provider latency, native WebKit responsiveness, or sustained process memory.
